title: Bob Ballard's search for Atlantis

tellings.quote: which they now say is up in the Red Sea. The Naval U has a consultant named Bob Ballard at the institute in Connecticut.

plain: The lost city of Atlantis is now said by some to lie in the Red Sea, and an ocean explorer named Bob Ballard, a consultant to a Navy institute in Connecticut, is said to have been looking into it. John S. Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy, mentions this to Michels as something tied to Ballard. He gives no details of what Ballard has found.
